network.name: Metro Pacific Health
network.blurb: Parañaque Doctors Hospital (PDH) is a proud member of Metro Pacific Health (MPH), the largest private hospital group in the country.
network.detail: The 27 hospitals that make up MPH include Makati Medical Center, Cardinal Santos Medical Center, Asian Hospital and Medical Center, Riverside Medical Center, and Davao Doctors Hospital, as well as 33 outpatient care centers, 6 cancer centers, 2 allied health colleges, a centralized laboratory, and several pharmacies across the country – all working together to deliver high-quality compassionate healthcare to Filipinos.

why.heading: Why PDH?
why.intro: Here at PDH, we go beyond healthcare. We provide genuine care that feels like home. Patients trust us because we put their well-being first, offering expert medical services, compassionate staff, and a welcoming environment that makes every visit reassuring.
why.detail: Our accessible location, developing facilities, and dedicated specialists ensure you receive the highest and best quality treatment without the hassle. Whether you’re here for a routine check-up or specialized care, PDH is where expertise meets heart, because you deserve nothing less.

pillars.title: Patient Safety
pillars.text: Our commitment is to place patient safety and top-tier medical standards at the forefront of everything we do.

pillars.title: Compassion & Medical Expertise
pillars.text: We deliver expert medical care with the warmth and compassion every patient deserves.

pillars.title: Cutting-Edge Science & Innovation
pillars.text: Your well-being inspires our focus on innovation.

pillars.title: Accessible & Inclusive Care
pillars.text: From Outpatient and Emergency to Inpatient and Urgent Care Services, we offer a comprehensive range of healthcare solutions tailored to your needs.

pillars.title: Community-Centered Service
pillars.text: We care beyond the clinic, strengthening lives through outreach and health advocacy.

about.intro: Parañaque Doctors Hospital (PDH) is a premier healthcare institution located in the heart of Parañaque City. It is committed to ensuring the well-being of its community by continuously providing high-quality and affordable healthcare services.
about.history: Founded on May 8, 2007, by visionary doctors, PDH officially became a member of the Metro Pacific Health (MPH) Group in 2024, the largest Philippine private hospital network in the country under the Metro Pacific Investments Corporation (MPIC), led by Mr. Manuel V. Pangilinan.
about.facilitiesLine: With a comprehensive range of medical facilities, including a 94-bed inpatient facility, Emergency Room (ER), Intensive Care Unit (ICU), Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), Operating Room (OR), Delivery Room (DR), Laboratory, and Radiology, PDH is also accredited by the Department of Health (DOH), PhilHealth, and various Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs), ensuring accessible healthcare and full compliance with government-regulated standards.
about.mission: To deliver “Alagang PDH”, our unique way of delivering high quality and compassionate care that is affordable, accessible, and patient-centered.
about.vision: To be the leading healthcare provider, renowned for medical excellence, compassionate care, innovative healthcare services, and dedicated commitment to the well-being of the community.
about.goal: To provide healthcare services that combine exceptional quality with affordability, making every experience at PDH truly worth it for our patients and their families.

barangayPartners.name: Barangay Don Bosco
barangayPartners.text: We’re thrilled to partner with Barangay Don Bosco! Through our Memorandum of Agreement, we are committed to improving healthcare access for the community. Just present your Barangay ID or any valid ID to enjoy exclusive PDH benefits.

barangayPartners.name: Barangay Sun Valley
barangayPartners.text: PDH has partnered with Barangay Sun Valley to enhance healthcare access and wellness. Present proof of residence, like your Barangay ID, and enjoy exclusive health benefits at PDH.
barangayPartners.photoAlt: PDH staff and Barangay Sun Valley officials at the barangay hall

barangayPartners.name: Barangay Marcelo Green
barangayPartners.text: Parañaque Doctors Hospital is proud to partner with Barangay Marcelo Green, marking a step towards better healthcare for the community. Simply show your Barangay ID for special benefits.

barangayPartners.name: Barangay San Antonio
barangayPartners.text: We’ve teamed up with Barangay San Antonio to bring better healthcare to the community. This partnership reaffirms PDH’s dedication to accessible healthcare and wellness.
barangayPartners.photoAlt: PDH and Barangay San Antonio officials at the partnership signing

barangayPartners.name: Barangay Upper Bicutan
barangayPartners.text: PDH has partnered with Barangay Upper Bicutan to bring quality healthcare closer to you. Just present your Barangay ID or government-issued ID to enjoy exclusive benefits.
barangayPartners.photoAlt: PDH staff and Barangay Upper Bicutan officials holding the signed agreement

barangayPartners.name: Barangay Napindan
barangayPartners.text: We’re excited to partner with Barangay Napindan to expand healthcare access. Stay tuned for more initiatives like health education and medical missions to better serve the community.
barangayPartners.photoAlt: PDH staff and Barangay Napindan officials holding the signed agreement

barangayPartners.name: Barangay Moonwalk
barangayPartners.text: PDH has officially partnered with Barangay Moonwalk to launch health education programs and community wellness initiatives. Stay tuned for more updates on our joint efforts for a healthier community.
barangayPartners.photoAlt: PDH staff and Barangay Moonwalk officials with the signed agreement

about.networkLine: As member of the MPH network, PDH shares the same goal in providing medical excellence and compassionate care to all our patients.
about.closing: More than just a healthcare provider, PDH is a steadfast partner in the community’s journey to wellness.
about.leadershipHeading: Guided by purpose. Driven by passion.
about.leadershipIntro: At PDH, our leadership team is the heart of our progress. With diverse backgrounds and a shared commitment to excellence, they bring together experience, innovation, and compassion to lead our hospital toward a future of patient-centered care and continuous growth.
about.barangayIntro: At PDH, we believe that meaningful healthcare starts at the grassroots. Through our strong collaborations with barangay leaders and local communities, we bring essential health education, medical services, and support closer to the people. These partnerships are the cornerstone of our mission to make quality healthcare more accessible, inclusive, and impactful for all.

testimonials.quote: I am very satisfied with PDH. Lalo na po sa Admitting Department. Mababait yung staff lalo na po si ma'am na laging naka kulay blue. Thank you din po sa Dr. naming. Salamat ng madami
Pagpatuloy lang ang pagbibigay urgent ng needs ng mga pasyente. Mabilis at OK naman over all. Dito na rin ang mga family ko nag papa check.
So far, PDH has been very convenient for me, and the healthcare staff are all kind and accommodating. I’m also truly thankful for my doctor’s excellent care and service.
Okay naman mabait ang doctor ko dito at pdh na talaga kami dati pa.
Mabilis ang proseso maganda malinis at maasikaso ang mga staff

stories.title: More Than a Hospital: A Second Home Built on Trust and Care
stories.excerpt: At Parañaque Doctors Hospital, care goes beyond medicine. It’s about building trust, offering comfort, and creating a second home for families facing life’s toughest challenges. This is the story of Thelma and her family.
stories.quote: What stands out most to us is the consistent warmth, attentiveness, and genuine care we receive from the PDH team, proof that compassion is at the heart of every visit.
stories.by: Rene, Thelma’s husband, PDH patient companion

stories.title: A Mother’s Journey of Hope and Healing
stories.excerpt: For Jennifer Danao, January 2025 was a time of worry, uncertainty, and ultimately, gratitude, marked by the dedication of the medical professionals who saved her six-year-old son.
stories.quote: From the time we arrived at the ER to the moment we were discharged, I felt assured that Lucio was in good hands.
stories.by: Jennifer Danao, mother of a PDH patient
